figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 1. A) Examples of P450-catalyzed RiPPs. B) Genome mining workflow of P450-catalyzed RiPP BGCs aided by SPECO and AlphaFold-
Multimer.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 2
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 2. MSSN and predicted complex of small-peptide–P450 pairs. A) MSSN analysis of 1962 small-peptide–P450 pairs, with P450 and small-
peptide sequence identities of 60% and 35%, respectively. B) Complex predictions of KstA-KstB, MciA-MciB, ScnA-ScnB, and SgrA-SgrB.
C) Sequence logos of precursor peptides and genomic content of four BGCs characterized in this study.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 3
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 3. Characterization of the product encoded by the kst BGC. A) UPLC-HRMS analysis of unmodified and modified KstA after trypsin digestion.
B) Tandem mass analysis of modified fragment after trypsin digestion. C) Cutouts of 600 MHz 1H-13C-HMBC and NOESY NMR spectra of 1.
D) Chemical structure of purified peptides 1 and 2 with key HMBC and NOESY correlations.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 4
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 4. Characterization of the product encoded by the mci BGC. A) UPLC-HRMS analysis of unmodified and modified MciA. B) Tandem mass
analysis of modified fragment after trypsin digestion. C) Cutouts of the 600 MHz 1H-13C-HMBC NMR spectrum (left) and key HMBC and NOESY
correlations (right) of 6. D) Chemical structure of purified peptide 6.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 5
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 5. Characterization of the product encoded by the scn BGC. A) UPLC-HRMS analysis of unmodified and modified ScnA. B) Tandem mass
analysis of peptides 9 and 10. The X residue at the C-terminus of 10 denotes a Gln residue with a 17 Da mass loss. C) Cutouts of 600 MHz 1H-13C-
HMBC and NOESY NMR spectra. D) Key HMBC and NOESY correlations of 10. E) ECD spectra of 10. F) Structure and formation of 10.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 6
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 6. Characterization of the product encoded by the sgr BGC. A) UPLC-HRMS analysis of unmodified and modified SgrA. B) Tandem mass
analysis of a modified fragment after TEV digestion. C) A cutout of the 600 MHz 1H-13C-HMBC NMR spectrum. D) Proposed chemical structure of
purified peptide 13 with key HMBC and NOESY correlations.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 7
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 7. Cyclic peptide diversification assay of KstA, MciA, and ScnA mutants. Gray connectors indicate two crosslinked residues. Numbers above
the residues indicate their positions in the precursor. Mutated residues of each precursor are underscored.
